observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor stage at night with stage lights, a banner reading 'UNIDOS NA DIVERSIDADE', and flags in the background.
observation.dancers: Large mixed group of men and women of various ages.
observation.formation_and_space: Initially in a wide line or curve holding hands, moving side to side and travelling.
observation.posture: Upright torso, slightly bent knees with grounded weight.
observation.footwork: Sideways stepping, shuffling, and tapping steps keeping rhythm with the music.
observation.arms_and_hands: Participants hold hands in a line, or hold white sashes/cloths and wave them up and down overhead.
observation.hips_and_torso: Minimal torso movement, steady posture with side-to-side body alignment as the group shifts.
observation.partnering: Group hold by hands in a line.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low to medium level steps, minimal jumping, occasional directional turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional-style garments including patterned skirts or loincloths, sashes, and elaborate feathered headdresses; holding white cloths.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and precise weight shifts are obscured by wide camera angles and low frame rate.

signature_moments.what: Holding hands in a line while stepping sideways and shuffling feet in unison.
Raising arms overhead while waving white cloths up and down while stepping.
